XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: ABS, ESP, service and tire pressure light on.
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: AIRBAG | U1726 | B1053 | CONTROL UNIT | ON | ON | YELLOW | YELLOW | RED | RED | TRIANGLE | DANGER | POINT | EXCLAMATION MARK |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage mechanic; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Airbag

  • Device: Airbag control unit

  • Fault: Airbag warning lights illuminated (yellow then red) and generic fault code

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system:
    • U1726 (No communication with airbag control unit)
    • B1053 (Injection control unit; safety inertia switch control signal – Perform self-diagnosis)
  • Cause: Faulty airbag control unit

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the airbag control unit; if necessary, repair or replace it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The faulty control unit showed no visible faults and, following its replacement, the problem was permanently resolved.
    The component is located on the underside of the dashboard, in the passenger compartment, on the centre tunnel beneath the air duct. It is accessible from beneath the glove compartment on the passenger side, after removing a plastic cover.
